reviewer: Separate pg_states_contract agent; internal AI-assisted review, not independent certification
scope: Read-only source review of Objects compatibility facade, inherited7.2.2 methods and authorization/event boundaries

findings.issue: Inherited rename checked source only; protected destination and directory child permissions could be bypassed
findings.resolution: rename requires administrator; broader per-file parity remains open

findings.issue: Protocol mismatch/malformed events signaled disconnect while leaving operations enabled
findings.resolution: fatalEventFailure stops client, clears facade and closes Store

findings.issue: Event count alone permitted large pending bytes and unbounded aggregate pattern work
findings.resolution: 16MiB pending payload bound,1MiB event bound,1024 patterns and shared2,000,000 matching work budget; simple prefix/literal fast paths

findings.issue: Initial glob implementation omitted classes/escapes and mismatched Unicode iteration units
findings.resolution: Reviewed States byte-wise glob implementation reused and positive cases added by Objects agent

findings.issue: unlink/delFile directory path directly called _rm, bypassing public rm administrator gate
findings.resolution: Lower-level _rm now checks administrator before inherited recursive operation
findings.status: fix confirmed by final source review

positiveObservations: Exact view map allowlist is compared as text; no new eval or arbitrary database-supplied code execution path.
Mutation wrapper enters shared Store transaction before authorization and inherited file mutation calls.
getObjectList postfilter examines full document in row.value.
Old object ACL is preserved by inherited _setObject when next ACL omitted.
limits: This reviewer did not independently execute Objects tests or PostgreSQL SQL/TLS/RLS tests.
No full application authorization proof: caller-supplied service user identities and shared database credentials remain a release blocker.
Nonadministrator file rename/directory operations are intentionally restricted pending full compatibility work.
No target hardware, migration, live controller/adapters or production/CRA/IEC acceptance established.
